fits.instructions: The input state contains a coding-agent session's `title` alongside its `recent` messages, ordered oldest to newest up to the latest turn. Judge whether the title still accurately reflects what the recent messages focus on. The title remains accurate when recent activity covers the titled task, a sub-step of it, a follow-up toward the same objective, or reviewing, testing, debugging, or shipping that change. It no longer fits once recent turns have shifted to an unrelated task, topic, or objective outside the title.

criteria.true:
Still fits:
- title "Fix parser crash on empty input", recent: adding a regression test for the empty-input crash
- title "Migrate auth to OAuth", recent: fixing CI failures on the OAuth branch, then opening the PR
- title "Investigate node outage", recent: confirming power and Ethernet recovery on that node
criteria.false:
No longer fits:
- title "Fix parser crash on empty input", recent: designing the settings page layout
- title "Migrate auth to OAuth", recent: benchmarking database query latency
- title "Review PR 412", recent: drafting a reply email to a customer
